templates.legs: Buy a lower-strike put and higher-strike call with the same expiration.

templates.name: Iron Condor
templates.legs: Sell an inner put and inner call, and buy a lower-strike put and higher-strike call with the same expiration.

templates.name: Iron Butterfly
templates.legs: Sell a call and put at the same middle strike, and buy lower-strike put and higher-strike call wings with the same expiration.

templates.name: Long Call or Put Butterfly
templates.legs: Buy one lower-strike option, sell two middle-strike options, and buy one higher-strike option of the same type, using equal strike spacing and one expiration.

templates.name: Long Calendar Spread
templates.legs: Sell a nearer-expiration option and buy a later-expiration option of the same type at the same strike.

templates.name: Long Diagonal Spread
templates.legs: Sell a nearer-expiration option and buy a later-expiration option of the same type at a different strike.

templates.name: Synthetic Long
templates.legs: Buy a call and sell a put at the same strike and expiration.

templates.name: Synthetic Short
templates.legs: Buy a put and sell a call at the same strike and expiration.

templates.name: Pairs Trade
templates.legs: Buy one security and borrow/short another using a specified sizing ratio.

templates.name: Futures Hedge
templates.legs: Combine an existing or new underlying exposure with a specified futures position and hedge ratio.

templates.name: Futures Calendar Spread
templates.legs: Buy one contract month and sell another contract month on the same underlying.

templates.name: Custom Multi-Leg
templates.legs: Build a validated package of supported instruments, financing, and hedging legs.
